finalAnswer:
Forest cover in the delivered 2021 map ranges from 0.0% of land area in Nauru to 92.07% in Federated States of Micronesia. Solomon Islands and Palau are also about 90%, Fiji, Papua New Guinea, and Samoa are high, Tuvalu and Vanuatu are mid-range, and Kiribati, Tonga, and Nauru are lowest.

The layer is already on your map with five quantile classes. Breaks are 24.97, 37.63, 56.83, and 83.51% of land area; values on a break go into the upper class. There are no No data countries in this fixed benchmark geography.
